title: Downward depression spiral had prevented me from visiting mall world for several months.
content: I can’t seem to get back to my mall world and it’s making my already depressed life worse. Mall world is a familiar place of comfort and I used to wake up being so grateful to have visited. Now I can’t seem to get back there and I fear I’ll never return. The only thing I can attribute it to is this depressive tailspin I’m in. Has this happened to anyone else? How did you get back?
